101B.1 / CHAPTER 1 OF 8

Thesis vs hygiene

A good story — but is there a reason to refuse?

Eight short chapters

01Thesis vs hygiene02Immediate rug risk03Slow extraction04Organic slow death05The self rug06Attention & catalyst expiry07Due diligence keeps moving08Clear decision states

01Definition

Thesis explains why demand could grow. Hygiene checks for failures that can disqualify the token.

02Why it matters

More upside evidence cannot cancel a severe structural failure.

03What to check

  • Timely narrative, credible attention, and actual buyers
  • Supply control, liquidity control, and trading permissions
  • What is verified, missing, or changing

04Healthy / Dangerous

Healthy

The thesis and the hygiene checks have separate evidence.

Dangerous

Excitement excuses a failed check or fills an evidence gap.

05Beginner mistake

Calling a polished website proof of safety.

06Takeaway

Strong thesis + failed hygiene = skip.

ILLUSTRATIVE · NOT A LIVE TOKEN

See the idea

  1. 01

    A meme attracts credible discussion and new buyers.

  2. 02

    A privileged controller can prevent ordinary exits.

  3. 03

    The attractive story does not repair that failure.

Trace it externally

Verify current permissions, sell restrictions, and liquidity control with chain-specific explorers and security tools. Meme Fast does not issue a hygiene clearance.

Go deeper

The source calls thesis additive and hygiene gating. Narrative, meta fit, X history, website claims, community independence, buyer growth, wallet behavior, and acceleration can support a thesis. None proves safety. Keep critical unknowns unresolved until evidence answers them; a pass is provisional, never a guarantee.
